context: Two teens walk home from a park clean-up event
purpose: Teach: 出口/ごみ/暗く/用事/食う/眺める/嫌わ/要ら

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 公園の出口、ごみが散らかってたよね。
lines.en: There was litter scattered all over the park exit.
lines.style: Direct observation, matter-of-fact tone. Light delivery, no accusation. Mentions it like a shared detail worth noting, not complaining.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、暗くなる前に拾えてよかった。
lines.en: Yeah, I'm glad we got it picked up before it got dark.
lines.style: Quiet agreement, understated satisfaction. Warm acknowledgment of 'we' — not making a big deal of the collaboration. Steady, grounded.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 明日は用事あるから、参加できないけど。
lines.en: I've got stuff to do tomorrow though, so I can't make it.
lines.style: Soft regret, slightly compressed pace. Not overapologizing, just honest. A tiny beat of guilt underneath but controlled. Trailing off slightly on the negation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 気にしないで。一人でもやるよ。
lines.en: It's fine, I'll do it solo.
lines.style: Reassurance without fussiness. Gentle but not self-sacrificing — matter-of-fact about going alone. Warmth that doesn't require a response.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: Want to grab something to eat on the way home?
lines.style: Natural shift to ease, light and inviting. Conversational rhythm of someone comfortable in the moment. No pressure, just including him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いいね。あの店、店員に嫌わない程度に長居しよう。
lines.en: Sure. Let's stay long enough to enjoy it but not so long the staff starts side-eyeing us.
lines.style: Dry humor delivered with a soft smile in the voice. Self-aware, a little playful. Acknowledges the unspoken shared understanding of lingering customers.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 夕焼け眺めるの好きなんだ、あの席から。
lines.en: I really like watching the sunset from that seat.
lines.style: Quieter, more inward. Genuine admission — tender without performing it. Slight vulnerability in the confession, like sharing something small and true.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 予約は要らないよね、平日だし。
lines.en: We don't need a reservation, it's a weekday.
lines.style: Practical, settling-things tone. Already thinking ahead, comfortable with logistics. Reassuring in its straightforwardness. Light close.
